theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_weyl_lemma
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (w : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient w g (ball 0 1) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, inner ℝ (g x) (gradient ζ x) = 0) → ∃ u : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (ball 0 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), u x = w x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), gradient u x = g x
